basic_info.main_problem: 在因忙于照顾孩子而错过最喜欢的节目《Face Off》的一集后，开始频繁出现“without用”“not够好”的自我标签；将小错误（如错过电视节目、not yet完成家务、晚餐not yet按时）看作整体失败，近来几乎每天出现并加重，影响自尊与日常生活。
basic_info.core_demands: I realize that these negative thoughts and feelings are affecting my daily life and self-worth, so I seek support in counseling.

special_situations.event: 因忙于照顾孩子而错过《Face Off》的一集
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果连这样的小事都not做到，就证明I am useless
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Tries to better organize my schedule, set reminders, or record programs to avoid missing again
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 我这么简单的事都记not住，我就是个without用的人。

special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Doubles down on time management and task prioritization, striving to catch up on all housework
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 连家务都做not完，我是失败的。

special_situations.event: 晚餐not yet能按时准备好

special_situations.compensatory_strategies: 更严格地安排与优化家庭日程，尝试设置更多提醒
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 我应该管理得更好，否则我是not称职的家长。

special_situations.event: 几乎每天在小任务或娱乐错过时出现without价值感

core_conflict.wish: Longs to be seen as a competent and valuable caregiver (parental role), gaining stable self-esteem and recognition
core_conflict.fear: 害怕因小失误被negate为失败者，从而失去价值感
defense_goal: Avoiding outside evaluation and maintaining a sense of safety by internalizing strict 'should' standards and self-isolation

object_relations.object_representation: 苛刻的评判者（内在化的角色期待与标准）

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: 当谈及或面对not yet完成的小任务、错过节目等具体失误时
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: Equates one mistake with overall failure, tying role value completely to perfect performance
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Maintain a gentle, accepting tone, name their internalized standards of 'should', invite exploration of the sources and functions of these rules; encourage distinguishing feelings from facts, and balance the self-evaluation with concrete evidence.

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: 在感觉“自己not够好”时与他人接触或准备分享感受的时刻
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: 认为接触会暴露自身的without能与失败，从而增加羞耻与被negate的风险
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: 以支持性、非评判的语气Reinforcement其自我关怀与界限觉察；use温柔的反映与正常化，邀请尝试低风险的分享（例如先与咨询师或可信朋友练习）。
